suitelet.name: SUST - Inspection and Regrade
suitelet.description: Demo 5.3 Inspection & Regrade: reclassify a received lot to a different grade item (same lot number) via Inventory Adjustment; copies quality attributes, stamps user/date/reason audit on both lots, writes Grade Transformation genealogy, and re-prices the linked supplier settlement on the new grade schedule (or flags for vendor credit when already paid).
